android.desc:
Monese is the banking alternative you’ve been waiting for.

We’re the money app that helps you budget smartly, spend wisely and switch between currencies in a flash. 

Whether you need a GBP, EUR or RON account (or all 3!), you’ll be able to manage your money straight from your phone and enjoy the flexibility to live, work, travel, study and thrive wherever life takes you. We even have business accounts!

Join over 2 million people and open a Monese mobile money account today. 

It’s simple, fuss-free and easy – so how does it work?

• Open a GBP, EUR or RON account, straight from your phone
• Easily switch between currencies and manage your money all in one place
• Get a contactless Mastercard debit card you can use globally – online, in-store or at ATMs
• Spend abroad with no extra fees on card spending and ATM withdrawals
• Quickly send and receive money locally and internationally in multiple currencies
• Create a virtual card and pay online or in-store for an extra layer of security
• Open a joint account to easily spend, share and save with a loved one, roommate or friend

With our feature-rich smartphone app, you’ll also get:

• Real-time notifications: Instant updates whenever you use your account
• A detailed spending overview: Full transparency around your transactions
• Savings pots: Put money aside for something special
• Google Pay: A fast, easy and secure way to pay with your Google Pay
• Automatic Direct Debits and recurring payments:  the easy way to pay for things like mobile phone contracts, rent, or gym memberships

Plus, you can also:


• Build your credit score: Use Credit Builder to grow your credit history and savings at the same time (UK only)
• Link your PayPal account: Manage your PayPal balance and transactions from Monese, and add your Monese card to your PayPal wallet
• Enjoy state-of-the art security features: 3D Secure, card locking, strong encryption and biometric login
• Get instant account statements in PDF or XLS whenever you need

Enjoy the convenience of being able to send and receive money straight from your phone, get your salary paid in, set up Direct Debits and recurring payments, all while maintaining a complete overview of your earning, spending and saving. Withdraw cash from ATMs worldwide for free, within generous allowances, and add money to your account by bank transfer, debit card, or with cash at over 84,000 locations in the UK, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, France, Luxembourg

quotes.text: The only real alternative to a UK bank that has actually launched and actually works is Monese. 20,000+ app installs in under 4 months since launch and an active community of users http://www.facebook.com/mymonese http://www.twitter.com/mymonese with plenty of reviews to read here https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.monese.monese.live&hl=en_GB  Euro accounts will also be landing this year, and transfers to a range of European currencies are supported at just 0.5% !! Plus the account is currently free !!!!
quotes.story_title: The bank of the future will be a marketplace
